Ahrefs Keywords Explorer, United States, read 2026-11-08: point volumes, marked 'Ahrefs US' in each note. SERP: local pack, Tripadvisor, Reddit, miamiandbeaches, Time Out. Venue names (LIV 17,000, Club Space 11,000, Ahrefs US) are navigational and not targeted.
